model.note: Least-squares fit of oneWayTypicalEur ~ base + perKm*km on the 20 low-cost, short-to-medium-haul samples (280-1670 km; SOF-TFS long-haul charter excluded as an outlier). Fit: base≈49.6, perKm≈0.0305 (rounded to 50 / 0.03). Legacy-carrier typical fares on the same distances run roughly 1.4-2.2x this low-cost baseline (see legacy samples) rather than following the same slope, so the app should apply a separate legacy multiplier (~1.8x) on top of this line, not extrapolate legacy prices from perKm alone.

infantUnder2PerLegEur.source: https://babytraveluk.co.uk/flying-with-a-baby-easyjet (easyJet infant charge £25 ≈ €28-29); Lufthansa charges ~10% of adult fare for lap infants on non-domestic-German routes (https://www.reducedmobility.eu/20150728639/TheNews/lufthansa-useful-faq-on-travelling-with-children , https://familieslovetravel.com/lufthansa-airline-policies-for-kids-and-infants/) — legacy figure here is a flat-euro approximation (~10% of a ~€220 typical short-haul legacy fare) for use in the calculator; real legacy pricing is percentage-based, not flat.

RO.period: 10 days (no weekly product exists; 1-day is 3.50 EUR)

notes: Flight model: base+perKm is least-squares fit on low-cost carrier samples only (R^2 moderate, ~0.3, because thin Balkan routes have high fare dispersion independent of distance); treat perKm as a rough slope, not a precise per-km cost, and always apply the spread multipliers rather than reading typical as exact. About 8 of the 27 flight samples are marked 'estimate' (no live fare captured this session) and interpolated from the nearest researched route of similar distance/origin type — flag these as lower-confidence if the site later gets a live fare feed. hotelSeasonFactor is calibrated on Croatian Adriatic coast data (PriceLabs 2025 vacation-rental ADRs, CroatiaTraveller, CroatiaUnscripted) and used as a Mediterranean-coast proxy; Greek islands and Spanish costas likely peak slightly later/flatter (Aug rather than Jul) but no country-specific series was sourced this run. hotelSeasonFactorCity has no single cited dataset — it encodes generally known European city-break seasonality (Christmas markets in Dec, conference season in Sep, August business lull) and should be treated as a soft estimate. Toll-per-km figures for RS, MK, ME, BA, PL, AL, GR, ES are conservative estimates (no authoritative per-km tariff table was found in this session) rather than sourced tariffs; Germany has no car tolls (0). Infant/child pricing mixes flat low-cost fees with a percentage-based legacy-carrier convention (Lufthansa: infant ~10% / child 2-11 ~75% of adult fare) approximated here as flat euro figures for calculator simplicity.
